Messages.Author: Mike Nudd
Messages.Body:
If you send someone to torpor and end combat with Rotschrek (out of your
turn obviously) is there still time to play Decapitate or Amaranth, or has
the combat already ended?

Regards,

Mike

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:


Combat ends with both combatants still ready.
Then, after combat ends, the victim goes to torpor.
